course.title: Coordinate Geometry and Differential Equations
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Find the length and the equation of the shortest distance between the lines (13) ${ \frac { x - 3 } { 3 } } = { \frac { y - 8 } { - 1 } } = { \frac { z - 3 } { 1 } }$ and ${ \frac { x + 3 } { - 3 } } = { \frac { y + 7 } { 2 } } = { \frac { z - 6 } { 4 } }$ . Also find the points where it intersects the lines.
